61371: Mashiro is the female protagonist of the story. She is the resident of room 202. She is a world-famous artist who transferred into Suiko as a second-year to learn how to draw manga.
64165: Misaki is the resident of room 201. Misaki is a third-year-student of Suiko who later attends Suimei University of the Arts. She is very outgoing and optimistic. Sorata often refers to her as an "alien".
64167: Nanami is Sorata's classmate. Although she is harsh to Sorata, she actually has a crush on him, and everyone aside from Sorata has noticed this. She escaped from her home to become a voice actress and has to live on her own.
64169: Sorata is the male protagonist of the story. He is a second-year student of Suiko, who lives in room 101 of Sakurasou Dormitory. He was kicked out of the standard school dorm after he chose not to throw away a stray cat he picked up.
64171: Jin is the resident of room 103 and a third-year student of Suiko. He is Misaki's childhood friend and a playboy. He has dated several girls, including Misaki's elder sister, but in the end he breaks up with all of them.
64173: Ryuunosuke is the resident of room 102 and a second-year student of Suiko. He is a hikikomori who rarely leaves his room, and usually communicates with others with cellphone message or e-mails. To reduce the need to communicate with others, he has written the "Maid" program.
64175: Chihiro is the dorm teacher of Sakurasou Dormitory and an art teacher of Suiko. Despite being a teacher, Chihiro is lazy and only cares about drinking alcohol and trying to date men. Despite being a teacher, she often gives Sorata improper advice.
72761: Sorata's little sister, who is currently attending 9th grade. She has a brother complex and even lied to her mom, so she could just meet with Sorata. Has also a complex about her flat chest.
73507: Rita was Mashiro's roommate and handler when Mashiro was in England. Despite her being the same age as Sorata and Mashiro, she has a better figure.
75350: Saori "Hau-Hau" Himemiya is the person Kamiigusa Misaki goes to for her audio. She's also the person who dates Tatebayashi Souichirou the ex-president of the Student Council.
75352: Boyfriend of Himemiya Saori and president of the student council. Also hates Jin.
75680: The older sister of Misaki. She looks like Misaki and she is Jin Mitaka ex-girlfriend.
76038: She is visual game original character. Briefly appears in the anime.
81267: He is the younger brother of Saori Himemiya
81325: Kanna is a first-year student and the highest scorer on entrance exam.
84923: Maid is Ryuunosuke's artificial intelligence (AI) program he wrote personally. Originally, Ryuunosuke designed Maid to filter and automatically reply to his cellphone messages and emails to save him time. However, Ryuunosuke keeps expanding Maid's AI ability.
